guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at Step 13 due to the issue: 'CondaError: Run 'conda init' before 'conda activate'. This happens because the Conda environment is not being correctly initialized before executing the 'conda activate testbed' command within the same RUN directive. To fix this issue, break down the commands into separate RUN directives. Modify Step 13 to: ```RUN conda init bash && echo 'source /opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh' >> ~/.bashrc && source /opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh``` followed by ```RUN conda activate testbed && conda config --append channels conda-forge && conda create -n testbed python=3.8 -y && pip install pytest junitparser typing_extensions```. This ensures conda initialization takes effect before activating environments.
